$schema_note: One JSON file per source in this bank/ folder. Structure below. UTF-8, no BOM.
source: string - short source id, e.g. github-user-repo, quizlet-set-name, pdf-title
license_note: string - what is known about usage terms, empty if unknown

questions.id: string - globally unique, format <source-key>-<nnn>, e.g. gh-bank-001
questions.part: 1 | 2 | null (1 = Scientific Foundations, 2 = Practical/Applied, null if source unknown)
questions.domain: string - exam content area if known, else null
questions.textbook_chapter: integer 1-26 or null (maps to cscs-exam-prep/raw/chXX.txt Chinese textbook)
questions.item_type: "mcq" (default, may be omitted) | "flashcard" (front/back cards from Quizlet/Cram/Brainscape: options=null, answer=null)
questions.question: string - English, exam style (flashcard: the front text)
questions.options: array of option strings (usually 4), or null for flashcard items
questions.answer: 0-based integer index into options, or null for flashcard items
questions.answer_text: string - copy of the correct option (redundancy for QA); for flashcard items: the back/definition text
questions.explanation_zh: string or null - Traditional Chinese explanation if source provides it or added by enrichment pass
